_comment: Single source of truth for the release targets (the six host archives). Consumed by .github/workflows/release.yml (the plan job feeds the build matrix), scripts/release.sh (which archives to expect and verify), and scripts/check-targets.sh (asserts install.sh / install.ps1 supported-triple lists agree). The install scripts are standalone (curl | sh) and cannot read this at install time, so the check keeps them in sync instead. runs-on matches ci.yml's pinned runner images; kind picks the build script (native = dist-native.sh, gnu/musl = the container scripts); archive is the file set release.sh checks (unix = .tar.gz + .tar.xz + mlir-dev, win = .zip + mlir-dev, musl = .tar.gz + .tar.xz, static).
